subject: general
question: Which of the following territorial disputes is going on between India and Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalapani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kalapani is a region located in the easternmost corner of Uttarakhand, India.
 
• The area is claimed by Nepal, which argues that it lies to the east of the Kali River, according to the Sugauli Treaty of 1815 signed between the British East India Company and Nepal.
 
• India, on the other hand, claims that the river marking the boundary is the one originating from the Limpiyadhura region, which puts Kalapani within Indian territory.
 
• The dispute escalated in 2019 when India published a new political map following the bifurcation of Jammu and Kashmir, showing Kalapani as part of its territory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Senkaku Islands Dispute:**

 
 
• The Senkaku Islands are a group of uninhabited islands in the East China Sea, which are disputed between China, Taiwan, and Japan.
 
• Japan currently administers the islands, but both China and Taiwan claim sovereignty over them.
 
• The dispute is rooted in historical claims and has significant implications for fishing rights and potential underwater oil reserves.
 
 
 
• **Sino-Indian Border Dispute:**
 
 
• The Sino-Indian border dispute involves large areas of territory along the Himalayan border between China and India.
 
• The main disputed areas are Aksai Chin (administered by China but claimed by India) and Arunachal Pradesh (administered by India but claimed by China).
 
• The dispute led to the Sino-Indian War in 1962 and continues to be a source of tension between the two countries.
 
 
 
• **Kuril Islands Dispute:**
 
 
• The Kuril Islands dispute is between Russia and Japan over sovereignty of the southernmost islands in the Kuril chain.
 
• These islands were taken by the Soviet Union at the end of World War II, but Japan claims they are part of its Northern Territories.
 
• The dispute has prevented the two countries from signing a formal peace treaty to end World War II hostilities.
